visual_goal: Show one product line splitting into two companies: a North American branch that went private and an international branch that grew by acquisition.
prompt: A left-to-right family-tree illustration of generic unbranded building tiles. Far left: a small office building labeled 'UK DMS vendor'. One arrow labeled '2005' to a larger building labeled 'Dealer services'. One arrow labeled '2014' to a building labeled 'Public company'. From 'Public company' three arrows fan out to the right: an upper thin grey arrow labeled '2020' to a small tile labeled 'Digital marketing'; a middle arrow labeled '2021' to a building labeled 'International business'; a lower arrow labeled '2022' to a plain building with a closed padlock on its door labeled 'North America, private'. From 'International business' one arrow right to a cluster of several small buildings around a globe labeled 'Acquisitions'. Buildings carry no flags, emblems or signs.
alt: A family tree: a UK DMS vendor joins dealer services in 2005, becomes a public company in 2014, sells digital marketing in 2020, splits off the international business in 2021, which grows by acquisitions, and goes private in North America in 2022.

visual_goal: Show two paths from the dealer to the data in the DMS: a credential path through an integrator that was blocked, and a certified path through a vendor access program, with courts reviewing terms and an exit path to a new DMS.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Left: a dealership building labeled 'Dealer'. Right: a large vault-like server labeled 'DMS'. Upper path, in grey dashed lines: one arrow from 'Dealer' labeled 'login' to a figure-less tool box labeled 'Integrator', then one dashed arrow from 'Integrator' to 'DMS' that ends against a red barrier just before the vault. Lower path, in solid teal: one arrow from 'Dealer' to a certified-badge tile labeled 'App vendor', then one arrow labeled 'fee per rooftop' to a gate labeled 'Access program', then one arrow labeled 'scoped access' into 'DMS'. Above the gate, a small scales-of-justice tile labeled 'Courts and law' with one dotted arrow down onto 'Access program'. Far right: one arrow from 'DMS' labeled 'export' to a second empty server labeled 'New DMS'.
alt: A dealer reaches its DMS data by two paths: a blocked credential path through an integrator, and a certified path through an app vendor and access program with a fee per rooftop; courts and law review the program, and an export arrow leads to a new DMS.

visual_goal: Show a marketplace gateway that routes calls on a published contract to whichever provider the dealer chose, while the platform keeps the contract registry, consent and billing.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Far left: a phone-and-laptop tile labeled 'Third-party app'. One arrow labeled 'contract API' into a central router hub labeled 'Gateway'. Above the hub, attached by a short line, a book tile labeled 'Contract registry'. Below the hub, attached by a short line, a checkmark-document tile labeled 'Dealer consent'. To the right, two generic unbranded server boxes stacked vertically, upper labeled 'DMS provider' and lower labeled 'Other provider'. One arrow from 'Gateway' to each provider, each labeled 'routes'. Lower right: one arrow from 'Gateway' to a meter tile labeled 'Billing'. Write the labels as plain text without any quotation marks.
alt: A third-party app calls a contract API at a gateway that has a contract registry and dealer consent attached; the gateway routes to a DMS provider or another provider and sends metered calls to billing.

visual_goal: Show the recovery order as swimlanes: shutdown, manual work, core restored, dealer validation, and integrations restored weeks later.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with four horizontal lanes, each headed at the left by an icon and a label: a server icon 'DMS platform', a building icon 'Dealer group', a puzzle icon 'Apps', and a clipboard icon 'Store staff'. Time flows to the right. Messages as arrows between lanes, left to right in order: an orange arrow from 'DMS platform' to 'Dealer group' labeled '19 June shutdown'; an arrow from 'Dealer group' to 'Store staff' labeled 'manual work'; a red broken arrow from 'Apps' to 'DMS platform' labeled 'calls fail'; a green arrow from 'DMS platform' to 'Dealer group' labeled 'core restored'; a small loop on the 'Dealer group' lane labeled 'validation'; and far right, a green arrow from 'DMS platform' to 'Apps' labeled 'July'.
alt: Swimlanes for the DMS platform, dealer group, apps and store staff: shutdown on 19 June, manual work, failing app calls, core restored, dealer validation, and app integrations restored in July.
